generate_supernet: generate a supernet architecture with configurable nodes and layer types for neural architecture search
sample_random_nets: sample multiple random sub-networks from a base supernet for one-shot NAS evaluation
flatten_supernet_to_vector: flatten normal and reduce cell supernets into a single 1D vector representation
encode_search_space: encode the supernet search space into constraint matrices A and b for hit-and-run sampling
check_supernet_availability: check if a flattened supernet vector has valid connectivity with exactly 2 operations per node
